home.intro: The <gi>Genshin Impact</gi> build calculator by <juanlab>JuanLab</juanlab>, based on Stellar Optimizer and Genshin Optimizer. Import your characters with your UID (Enka or Akasha), find the best build with what you have and simulate team rotations, beta characters included.
home.importHint: Loads the characters in your showcase, with equipped weapons and artifacts, into the current database. You'll see a preview of what changes before saving. Character details must be visible in the game.
home.credits1: Juan-optimizer is based on <go>Genshin Optimizer</go> by <frzyc>frzyc</frzyc> and all its <contrib>contributors</contrib> (<mit>MIT</mit> license): the base calculations, data and interface are their work. The original site is <site>frzyc.github.io/genshin-optimizer</site>.
home.credits2: Player showcases from Enka.network. This copy is by JuanLab (source code) and is not affiliated with the original project.
home.credits3: Genshin Impact is a trademark of HoYoverse. This site is not affiliated with or endorsed by HoYoverse.
home.importHintAkasha: Loads every build saved on Akasha, several per character, into the current database. Before saving you see a preview of what changes.
home.creditsStellar: The optimizer, rotations, KQM Setup, ER calculator and beta kits come from Stellar Optimizer by s-naveen and its contributors. That is why Juan-optimizer is released under the GNU AGPL v3: the source code is public.

card.title: Comparison card
card.alt: {{team}} compared: the original (A) against a version (B)
card.sameMembers: Same members: another rotation or settings

items: **Burst scenarios** (Team optimize and KQM): compare a character’s Burst every rotation, every 2nd, every 3rd or never (with an action in its place, such as N4). Each scenario gets its Energy Recharge and builds recalculated, ranked by team DPS.
**Faster Team optimize**: the optimization runs off the page, which stays smooth, and alternative weapon and set rankings are quicker.
Rankings show up to three 2+2 set pairs per character beside the 4-piece sets.
Write rotation suggests commands and tips fitted to the team (Mavuika, Beidou, Sandrone…) and opens the Notes expanded.
The weapon chooser hides 1–2★ weapons and those under level 70 by default, with a button to show them.
Optimize rotation shows the current rotation’s length beside the Energy Recharge it needs, and scores rotations with the team’s ER settings.
Team optimize no longer gives the main carry an energy weapon like Favonius in round 1 just because a teammate hasn’t been optimized yet.
Varesa: her Skill charges recharge one at a time, and Fiery Passion ends when she swaps out after a plunge that spent her Nightsoul points.
The new texts (Burst scenarios, weapon chooser, rotation tips) are in Italian too.

entries.title: Reactions in the timeline
entries.summary: You can now see which reactions happen and when.

items: **Reactions row in the timeline**: a mark for each reaction of the on-field member, in its colour (full for forward Melt and Vaporize ×2, hollow for reverse ×1.5). Hovering one shows the moment, who triggered it and with which hit.

**Reactions section in Write rotation**: per member, how many of each reaction and the list with the second and the hit. Switch from “On field” to “All” to also see the ones triggered off field (such as Citlali’s Frostfall Storm on Mavuika’s Pyro).
**DPR on the versions picture**: each team shows its damage per rotation beside its DPS.

entries.title: Mavuika’s Melt and the hit list
entries.summary: A fix to the rotation’s hit list, and a guide to Mavuika’s Melt with Citlali.

items: **Hits per rotation**: reactions no longer show twice (“Frostfall Storm (Melt) (Melt)”), and melting hits sit under their attack instead of a row of their own (“Charged Attack: Cyclic, Cyclic · Melt, Final · Melt”).

**Mavuika with Citlali**: her charged attacks melt only when Citlali lays Cryo after her burst, that is with `Citlali E Q N1` (5 of 13 charged attacks, as Prydwen counts). With `Citlali E Q` or `Citlali E N1 Q` Mavuika’s Pyro aura stays on the enemy and she never melts. The full explanation is in docs/mavuika-citlali-melt.md.
**A Melt rotation template for Mavuika, Citlali, Xilonen and Bennett.**
**Advanced artifact sets**: builds can allow or forbid two 2-piece bonuses (2+2+1, 3+2) and mixed pieces.
**Faster Team optimize with big inventories**: Quick searches in full only the weapons that can come close to the best, and skips weaker copies.
Team optimize puts meeting Energy Recharge and artifact requirements first, stops at once when a minimum can’t be reached, and says how far off it is.
**Mavuika**: tapping her Skill during Nightsoul’s Blessing switches form, as in gcsim, and a cancelled Charged Attack no longer fires its finisher later.
Citlali’s Nightsoul points no longer go past 100; Faruzan makes particles only from Pressurized Collapses.
With every set but one turned off, every build wears 4 pieces of it; the inspector ranks a member’s best build among its sets.
The new texts are in Italian too.
**Team optimize results** are simpler: the strip of the next team builds and the run window’s Builds choice are gone. The alternatives are in **Top builds**, under the results.

entries.title: Update to Stellar Optimizer 1.40
entries.summary: Stellar Optimizer’s releases 1.39.1 and 1.40.0 arrive, and the versions picture gets the detailed view.

items: **Usable by** on each weapon, in Team optimize and KQM: a Favonius is only tried on the members you choose.
**ER: Automatic or Manual**, in Team optimize and KQM. In Automatic, Favonius and other energy weapons show what they save each member on their card, where their triggers can be set too.
**Rotation writer**: a warning when the rotation waits for cooldowns (what waits, and how long); the timeline can show every rotation played.
Optional Bursts (Q?, Q/N3, EQ/E) count as every 2nd Burst in the ER calculator.
Result cards are easier to read and show each member’s ER requirement.
Weapon and set lists tick instantly; Team optimize keeps phones responsive while it runs.
Using a rotation no longer turns buffs such as Cryo resonance back on in the team settings.
Manual ER stays Manual when the rotation changes; the ER calculator’s dropdowns open on top again.
Cryo Traveler: Charged Attack: Freezing Ice shows in Cryo.
**Versions → Share: Normal or Detailed**. The detailed picture adds each member’s main stats and stats out of combat, as on the KQM team card.
The Comparison card (original against one version) is gone: Stellar’s versions picture replaces it.
The new texts are in Italian too.
**Team optimize: Top builds and Damage share** in the results, as on the KQM tab: the best team, then the best builds that change one member’s weapon or set.
**Member inspector**: after a run, pick a member to rank its other weapons and artifact sets by team damage.
**Automatic gear effects**: Team optimize turns on weapon and set effects you haven’t set, and times set effects from the rotation. What you set yourself still wins.
**Optimize team dialog redesigned**: one line per member with sets, set effects, main stats and minimum ER; choose Best build or All builds instead of a number.
**Simpler Artifact sets dialog**: a switch per set, effects in each row, 2-pc/4-pc under Advanced; mixed builds are always considered.
**Damage share** keeps Stellar and Lunar damage apart from their element’s other damage.
**Quieter results header**, and no jumps while the other builds are ranked.
**Yae Miko**: her Charged Attack hits once per cast (it was counted twice).
**Danica C2**: her first swap-in of a fight plays Will to Protect, as in the game.
**Valeriy**: the Burst turret fires the right number of shells, at the right time.
**Arlecchino** (Masque bonus and C1 need 30% Bond of Life) and **Citlali** (C1 bonus to the active member only).
**Rotation timeline**: clicking a Burst whose hit lands after the member’s next action opens that hit.
The new texts are in Italian too.
**Versions: Run all is always there**, so every version can run again even when they are all up to date.
**Faster team searches on the GPU**: a member’s next weapons are solved alongside, and teams with long rotations no longer fall back to the CPU.

**Rotations**: a character’s buffs from their Skill or Burst only count when the rotation uses that Skill or Burst. A buff left on in the character’s own settings no longer adds damage to a rotation without it.
**Team optimize**: opening a grouped attack row no longer crashes the page on some imported teams.

**KQM versions: keep teammates’ gear**: in New version, tick it and the members shared with the original keep its builds; only the changed ones (another character, constellation or signature) are searched. Handy for C0 with signature vs C1 without.
The new texts are in Italian too.
**Optimize rotation on Team optimize too**: rotations are played with your last run’s builds, and the best get builds from your own artifacts and weapons.
**Enemies that can’t be frozen** (bosses by default, as in gcsim): Hydro and Cryo still react, but no Frozen or Shatter.
**Danica**: frames from a game recording, N3-4 carries a Normal Attack string on, and her rotation says why her Anchor ran out.
**Cyno C1**: Normal Attack SPD from any Judication, no Burst needed.
**Danica, the Tsaritsa, Silverdawn and Torrents of Spring** follow beta 7.2.53. The numbers are updated; the Italian talent descriptions stay the previous beta’s until the new ones exist in Italian.
The 12 new texts are in Italian too.

entries.title: Update to Stellar Optimizer 1.35
entries.summary: Stellar Optimizer’s releases 1.24 to 1.35 arrive. The biggest is **Optimize rotation** in KQM Theorycrafting; KQM artifacts now come in tiers, and a team can have versions to compare.

sub: Tries thousands of small changes to the written rotation (order, members coming back, attack strings, skills and kit options) and plays them with the KQM builds. The main DPS keeps its Burst and field time.
**Quick** stops at its time limit. **Full** also tries the other member orders and the templates, then gives the best rotations their own KQM builds.
A rotation that needs less Energy Recharge gains the damage stats that frees. The best show up while it searches, with each member’s ER need.
Besides KQM Standard: **Good**, **Great**, **Top** and **Perfect**, built piece by piece as the game makes them.
**Custom** is back: how many of each member’s 45 rolls land on wanted stats (10 to 45), the rest random.
Set for the whole team or per member, in the Setup members table. Share pictures say which standard the builds used.
**Lock a weapon** for a member: every build of it uses that weapon, the others optimized around it.
**Signature weapons** per member: never, or R1 to R5. With several refinements ticked, builds use the highest.
Duplicate a team or make a version by swapping members: it shares the original’s KQM settings.
Versions run in the background and are compared in a table (DPS, ER required, field time, share) and in a share picture.
KQM results are kept for up to 100 teams.
A team opened with a link from another site comes in with its builds: run them as they are (marked **TC**) or switch to My builds.
**Quick** and **Full** search: Quick narrows each slot to the artifacts that can matter. Small searches use the GPU too.
Skill particles go to whoever is on the field as the rotation plays; turrets count, and Beidou’s 1-stack hold.
Constellation, passive, set and weapon Energy is filled in from the written rotation.
The first rotation written apart is a setup, not counted, unless ticked.
What raises team damage also for the KQM builds shown, saved with the run.

items: **Anastasya**: ascension, Vortices and C6. **Wriothesley**: C4 and C6.
**Nicole** C6, **Lohen** (both hits of the Charged Attack), **Sucrose** (her bonuses start off without her Skill or Burst), **Iansan**, **Varesa** C2 in the ER calculator.
**Silken Moon’s Serenade** triggers on zero-damage element applications too (Nilou); **Thrilling Tales of Dragon Slayers** counts only after the member swaps out.
**Optimize rotation** no longer runs the tab out of memory on teams with many buffs.
**Other**: imports no longer hide imported items behind active filters; Bennett’s Burst field shows on the timeline.
Every new text is in Italian too (220 texts).

**Comparison card in Versions**: the KQM Compare section is gone; from the team's Versions, Comparison card sets the original (A) against the version open (B), on the original the one you pick. Every member changed is marked, with its turns in the rotation, several swaps too.
The **Feedback** button is back: it opens a GitHub issue and posts to JuanLab’s Discord.
The home page and the footer invite you to JuanLab’s **Discord server**.

entries.title: Update to Stellar Optimizer 1.23
entries.summary: Stellar Optimizer’s releases 1.17 to 1.23 arrive. Written rotations move into their teams by themselves; the first KQM result has to be run again, as KQM now keeps its own settings.

sub: In Write the rotation, and on the start screen of an empty rotation, **Templates** lists standard rotations for the main DPS characters, from KQM’s guides and team calcs (community calcs where KQM has none). Your team’s characters come first.
Picking one opens it in the writer; members it uses that are not in your team are left out.
7 templates have their **optimized version** beside them, found by a rotation search at KQM builds.
`Q/N3` or `Q?/N3`: the Burst when it is ready, else N3; `E/N2CA` the same for a Skill on cooldown. The notes say when the alternative was played.
`WK` (walk, `WK11f` = 11 frames); `HP` and `LP` (high and low plunge, `HP[collision]` for the hit on the way down).
`CA[cancel]` (Arlecchino), `CA[bullets=4]` (Chasca), `CA[weakspot]` (Lyney); `D?/CA` for Wanderer.
**Its own rotation**, apart from Team optimize’s, played at the Setup’s constellations. It starts as a copy; then Copy from Team optimize and Copy from KQM Theorycrafting copy it either way.
**Its own settings**: enemy, team buffs, kit switches and extra buffs. A passive switched off on Team optimize no longer changes KQM’s results.

**Quick search** (the default): after the first round each member only tries the weapons and sets near its best, the rest listed as screened out under the rankings. **Full** tries them all, as before.
Weapon rows show Passive on, or the share of the fight it is on; each pick says how it changes the teammates’ ER required (Favonius particles, for example).
Changing a constellation plays the rotation again by itself, and a notice says what changed.
**ER calculator**: counts the refunds of Bloodsoaked Ruins, Jadefall’s Splendor, Lumidouce Elegy and Amenoma Kageuchi.
**Each member’s Min ER** worked out from the written rotation, as KQM does; adjust it with Calculate ER.
**Undo equip**: puts back the equipment and saved builds from before the last Equip.
**Export and Import attacks** as JSON.
**Rotations counted**: Steady DPS (rot 3–4), the default, or the first 1–6 rotations counted from the start, like a timed challenge.
Written rotations are saved **with their team**, not only in the browser: duplicating a team copies them, deleting it removes them, the export includes them.
The team export can be downloaded as a JSON file.
A compact team header with a back arrow; when no team matches the search, Clear filters brings them back.
**Domovoy Sculptor**: Radiance: Stellar Glimmer turns its sculptures into statues that explode on it and take its RES down.
**Guardian Blade of Drifting Snow**: its Ice Coffin (a shield under Radiance); one that holds 20 s gives HP back.
**Chimeric Winged Lion**: Electro Ward, backlash, flight and vortex.
**Secret Source Automatons**: Sweeper Mode stopped by Cryo, Forced Counterstrike, Adaptive Countermeasures and the Boltsphere Cannon.
The fight timeline shows the team’s damage every 3 s, into shields and wards too.
Against the Radiant Moongecko, Team optimize picks builds with Disentangled’s CRIT Rate and DMG Bonus in mind.

items: Rotation damage: Geo resonance comes from shields and Crystallize shards are picked up on dashes (Itto, Navia); Kazuha absorbs Pyro inside Bennett’s field; Bennett’s field ATK goes only to who stands in it; Finale of the Deep tracks its Bond of Life.
Kit fixes for Cyno, Fischl, Clorinde, Navia, Itto, Wanderer, Xiao, Diluc, Chasca and Tartaglia.
An attack played with different members on the field or different buffs is one row with its total; open it to see each part and what sets it apart.
Attacks changed by hand are marked Attacks edited.
Typing in the writer no longer slows the page behind it.
KQM’s Damage share follows the rotation played and each hit’s real element.
The rotation notes say when Danica’s Skill drops no particles (their shared 14 s cooldown).
**Arlecchino C2**: lands before her next Normal Attack, so in Melt it no longer takes her Cryo.
**The Widsith**: plays the song picked, not the average of the three.
**Equip**: works for members on a saved build too.
**Burst every 2nd or 3rd rotation**: the rotations without it still play the short Bursts (Flins’ Thunderous Symphony, Varesa’s Volcanic Kablam).
**No-energy start**: the first rotation no longer waits for what the Bursts would have made ready.
**Other**: results marked out of date when the members change, safer imports, the Custom enemy no longer keeps a boss’s HP.
Every new text is in Italian too (113 texts, with the game’s own names).
KQM Compare reads KQM’s rotation where it now lives, and keeps the weapons and sets picked in KQM Theorycrafting’s inspector.
ER calculator: a warning when the rotation uses Flins’ full Burst together with Thunderous Symphony.
The home page, the footer and the missing Feedback button stay as before.
